wizard.title: Rustmail setup
wizard.unauthorized_title: This setup link is missing its token
wizard.unauthorized_description: Open the exact link Rustmail printed in the server console when it started. It ends with a one-time token, and expires once setup is done.
wizard.welcome_description: Six short steps: the bot token, your servers, where tickets go, the web panel, language, and a final review. Keep the Discord Developer Portal open in another tab.
